query.statement: INSERT INTO TB_SAFETYINCIDENT (SAFETYINCIDENT_ID, NAME, STATUS_CD, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, SYSDATE, ?, SYSDATE)
SELECT SAFETYINCIDENT_ID, NAME, STATUS_CD, UPDATED_AT FROM TB_SAFETYINCIDENT WHERE NAME LIKE '%' || ? || '%' AND STATUS_CD = ? ORDER BY UPDATED_AT DESC
SELECT SAFETYINCIDENT_ID, NAME, STATUS_CD, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT FROM TB_SAFETYINCIDENT WHERE SAFETYINCIDENT_ID = ?
UPDATE TB_SAFETYINCIDENT SET NAME = ?, STATUS_CD = ?, UPDATED_BY = ?, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE SAFETYINCIDENT_ID = ?
